downloads.notes: Mac/Xcode handoff kit for producing the signed macOS/iOS archive. Not a notarized app bundle.
macOS UI demo app package. Build this on an Apple Silicon Mac with securewave_app/scripts/package_macos_ui_demo.sh; VPN tunneling is not enabled in the macOS demo.
macOS UI demo app package. Build this on an Intel Mac with securewave_app/scripts/package_macos_ui_demo.sh; VPN tunneling is not enabled in the macOS demo.
Windows installer appears here after the Windows release runner publishes it. Current Windows VPN routing is WireGuard-only and still needs host proof.
Debian/Ubuntu package appears here after x64 build evidence and clean VM helper/systemd proof. Full routing requires the privileged helper installed once.
Portable AppImage appears here after the Linux release runner publishes it. Portable mode is UI-only unless a separate privileged helper install is completed.
Portable Linux x64 tarball is withheld until a true x86_64 artifact is published. Portable mode is UI-only unless a separate privileged helper install is completed.
Portable Linux ARM64 UI package. VPN routing is not claimable from archive extraction unless the privileged helper and host VPN tools are installed separately.
Android APK appears here after the Android release runner publishes it.
iOS is distributed through TestFlight/App Store after Apple Network Extension approval.
